paragraphs.text: 摘要：为兼顾小时级骨干网络流量预测中的短期波动与长期趋势，设计一种轻量自适应多尺度预测模型。模型在三种时间分辨率上输入历史窗口数据，分别经由独立分解线性专家生成预测结果，再由路由网络从当前窗口提取均值、标准差、末时刻均值和平均绝对一阶差分，多层感知器据此计算融合权重。以Abilene和GÉANT为实验数据，均以 96 步历史输入预测未来 24 步。在3个共同随机种子下，与单尺度分解线性模型相比，方法的均方误差分别降低4.07%和4.54%；相对采样导向轻量模型LightTS，降幅达到29.80%和46.89%。进一步的8种子消融实验中，相对全局可学习权重和恒定输入路由，在Abilene上逐种子平均改进率均约为1.80%，GÉANT分别为4.31%和4.97%。结果表明，多尺度候选预测配合低维路由机制，仅引入少量融合参数即可获得更低的平均预测误差，输出结果可为次日网络流量需求分析与容量规划提供参考。

paragraphs.text: Abstract: A lightweight adaptive multiscale forecasting model was developed to account for short-term fluctuations and long-term trends in hourly backbone network traffic forecasting. Historical windows were represented at three temporal resolutions, and independent decomposition linear experts generated candidate forecasts. A routing network extracted four statistics from the current window: the mean, standard deviation, mean at the last time step, and mean absolute first difference. A multilayer perceptron with two fully connected layers used these statistics to calculate fusion weights. Experiments on Abilene and GÉANT used 96 historical steps to predict the next 24 steps. Across three common random seeds, the proposed method reduced mean squared error by 4.07% and 4.54% relative to the single-scale decomposition linear model, respectively. The corresponding reductions relative to the sampling-oriented lightweight model LightTS were 29.80% and 46.89%. Further ablation experiments across eight random seeds compared the proposed method with learned global weights and a constant-input router. On Abilene, the mean seed-wise improvements over both controls were approximately 1.80%; on GÉANT, they were 4.31% and 4.97%, respectively. The results show that combining multiscale candidate forecasts with low-dimensional routing achieves lower mean forecasting errors with few additional fusion parameters. The forecasts can provide a reference for next-day network traffic demand analysis and capacity planning.
